body:
Now: 15 coins every round, win or lose, no limit.
New: the first 3 rounds a game day pay 15 each; after that it's just for fun (XP still counts, with Balance 2's limit). Same as football and tennis, which already pay once a day.

comments.text: Karolis said 'do the rebalance' in the Schedules and economy chat (30 Oct): approved. Built as a code patch (economy-rebalance.patch, build 2026103101) and checked with the quick kit; goes live through a pull request in the next repo chat.

short: Dance-off pays only the first 3 rounds a day
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy red team
title: Balance 4: dance-off coins once a day
